title: mir
description: Machine-readable description of an X Intrinsics (Xt) widget set, primarily Motif.

prefix.description: Toolkit prefix stripped from widget class names to derive humanName.

include.description: Path to the header file that declares the widget class.

humanName.description: Human-readable name of the widget class, derived by stripping the toolkit prefix and the trailing WidgetClass suffix.

functions.description: List of functions associated with the widget, filtered to only those whose name starts with prefix + humanName (case-insensitive).
